quota_name: Account-level read throughput quota (Provisioned mode)
description: The maximum number of aggregate read capacity units (RCUs) allocated for the account per region; applicable only for tables in provisioned read/write capacity mode. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/keyspaces/latest/devguide/quotas.html

quota_name: Account-level write throughput quota (Provisioned mode)
description: The maximum number of aggregate write capacity units (WCUs) allocated for the account per region; applicable only for tables in provisioned read/write capacity mode. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/keyspaces/latest/devguide/quotas.html

quota_name: Concurrent DDL operations
description: The maximum number of concurrent DDL operations allowed per region. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/keyspaces/latest/devguide/quotas.html

quota_name: Keyspaces per region
description: The maximum number of keyspaces that can be created per region.

quota_name: Max amount of data restored using add Region operations
description: The maximum size of data that can be concurrently restored by add Region operations.

quota_name: Max amount of data restored using Point-in-time Recovery (PITR)
description: The maximum size of data that can be restored using PITR within 24 hours.

quota_name: Max amount of direct child UDTs per UDT
description: The maximum number of child UDTs supported for a UDT.

quota_name: Max amount of direct parent UDTs per UDT
description: The maximum number of parent UDTs supported for a UDT.

quota_name: Max clustering key size
description: The maximum combined size of all clustering columns. Up to 4 bytes of additional storage are added to the raw size of each clustering column for metadata. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/keyspaces/latest/devguide/quotas.html

quota_name: Max concurrent imports from Amazon S3
description: The maximum number of concurrent import operations per account per region.

quota_name: Max concurrent table restores using Point-in-time Recovery (PITR)
description: The maximum number of concurrent table restores using PITR per subscriber is 4

quota_name: Max number of tables per UDT
description: The Maximum number of tables that can refer to a particular UDT.

quota_name: Max number of UDTs per AWS Region
description: The maximum number of UDTs that can be created per region across all keyspaces.

quota_name: Max number of UDTs per table
description: The maximum number of UDTs that a table can reference.

quota_name: Max partition key size
description: The maximum size of the compound partition key. Up to 3 bytes of additional storage are added to the raw size of each column included in the partition key for metadata. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/keyspaces/latest/devguide/quotas.html

quota_name: Max row size
description: The maximum size of a row, excluding static column data. For details see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/keyspaces/latest/devguide/quotas.html

quota_name: Max S3 object size for import from Amazon S3
description: The maximum size of a single Amazon S3 object in an import operation.

quota_name: Max S3 objects per import from Amazon S3
description: The maximum number of Amazon S3 objects per import operation.

quota_name: Max Schema size
description: The maximum size for a table schema. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/keyspaces/latest/devguide/quotas.html

quota_name: Max static data per logical partition
description: The maximum aggregate size of static data in a logical partition. For details see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/keyspaces/latest/devguide/quotas.html

quota_name: Max subqueries per IN SELECT statement
description: The maximum number of subqueries you can use for the IN keyword in a SELECT statement.

quota_name: Max total import source size from Amazon S3
description: The maximum total size of source data across all concurrent import operations per account per region.

quota_name: Max UDT name length
description: The maximum number of characters in the UDT name.

quota_name: Max write capacity for a table using change-data-capture (CDC)
description: The maximum write capacity for Amazon Keyspaces tables with CDC enabled. This default quota only applies to tables in provisioned read/write capacity mode.

quota_name: Table-level read throughput quota
description: The maximum read throughput (RCUs & RRUs per second) that can be allocated to a table in the region. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/keyspaces/latest/devguide/quotas.html

quota_name: Table-level write throughput quota
description: The maximum write throughput (WCUs & WRUs per second) that can be allocated to a table per region. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/keyspaces/latest/devguide/quotas.html

quota_name: Tables per region
description: The maximum number of tables that can be created per region across all keyspaces.
